name: bettercad
description: A free, browser-based CAD tool for 3D printing.

scripts.build: npm run tokens && tsc -b && npm run build -w web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:occt: node packages/kernel/occt/config.mjs && cd packages/kernel/occt/build && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" ghcr.io/taucad/opencascade.js@sha256:d7bf97ada840afb0f0e0f6bba04b1b55dd0d276e1679a3e40c1431a2cf44900b link bettercad.yml && node ../sizes.mjs bettercad_occt.wasm
scripts.test:nightly: NIGHTLY=1 vitest run packages/kernel/src/nightly.test.ts packages/kernel/src/golden.test.ts packages/sketch/src/golden.test.ts packages/kernel/src/timeline.test.ts packages/kernel/src/samples.test.ts
